sessionId.description: The project's MOST RECENT session — the same one `projects-summary` reports in `latestSessionId`.

events.description: In DESCENDING `seq` order — the first item is the most recent (RN-100). At most 50 per project, the same cap `GET .../events` applies without `limit`, and when there are more unread than that the ones returned are the NEWEST. How many were left out comes from `latestSeq` minus the cutoff, without another request.

seq.description: Order within the session. Monotonic and gapless.

type.description: Event type. The full inventory is in `docs/reference/events.md`.

id.description: The user's id when `kind=user`; the agent's slug when `kind=agent`.

payload.description: Free-form shape, specific to each `type`. See the events reference.

400.description: Invalid body. The `ValidationPipe` runs with `whitelist` and `forbidNonWhitelisted`, so an unknown field also fails.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

404.description: Workspace doesn't exist or is invisible to the caller.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
